name: Thunar glass theme
description: GTK theme generator tweaks for a frosted-glass Thunar: 0.85 window opacity, a flat grey selection pill (Thunar paints it from theme_selected_bg_color in C), transparent icon-view cells, plus a matugen template that writes the wallpaper accent to ~/.cache/ambxst/thunar-folder-color.txt and runs ~/.local/bin/ambxst-sync-thunar-icons.sh to recolour the folder icons.
author: drpezzer
permissions: Rewrites ~/.config/gtk-3.0/gtk.css and ~/.config/gtk-4.0/gtk.css on every theme change
Runs ~/.local/bin/ambxst-sync-thunar-icons.sh as a matugen post hook if it exists
